 s=Session('/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start();t=time.time()
 paths=pickle.load(open(ROOT+'/paths.pkl','rb'))
 loaded=None; errors=[]
 def move(pos,speed=.15,settle=3):return p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
 def dip(k):
  nonlocal loaded

  x,y=s.wells()[k]['center_xy'];move([x,y,.065]);move([x,y,.024],speed=.07,settle=5);move([x,y,.065],speed=.09)
  loaded=k
 for ix,stroke in enumerate(paths):
  k=stroke['color'];path=stroke['path'];
  if k!=loaded:dip(k)

  xyz=np.c_[xs,ys,.02-dep*.001]
  move([xs[0],ys[0],.046]);move(xyz[0],speed=.06,settle=5)
